I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. It has no lodash import left, and the exported signatures are unchanged. I did not run an equivalence check against the original, so the behaviour match below comes from reading the code.

`npm run size -- out/module.ts` prints 206 bytes (min+gzip), with 95 bytes of my own code. I did not measure `src/module.ts`, so I can't say how that compares to the original.

`tsc --noEmit` reported errors only for `src/module.ts`, which can't find the `lodash/*` modules or their types. It reported none for `out/module.ts`, but I did not check that `out/` is covered by `tsconfig.json`.

| lodash | es-toolkit | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `keyBy(rows, fn)` | `keyBy` | Later rows win on duplicate ids, and keys become strings, as in lodash. |
| `sumBy(rows, 'age')` | `sumBy(rows, (row) => row.age)` | The string shorthand isn't supported, so I used a small callback. An empty array gives 0. |
| `sortedUniq` | `uniq` | `sortedUniq` isn't in es-toolkit. `uniq` keeps first occurrences in order, so it gives the same result for the sorted integer input. |

I didn't use `es-toolkit/compat` because the strict functions were enough.
